This page displays selected operational weather and climate maps from the **Climate Reanalyzer**, providing a snapshot of the current state of the Earth system.

These products are updated regularly and are useful for monitoring ongoing weather patterns and large-scale climate anomalies.

---

## 🌊 Sea Surface Temperature Anomalies

Sea surface temperature (SST) anomalies highlight regions that are warmer or cooler than the climatological average. Persistent SST anomalies play a key role in climate variability, influencing phenomena such as El Niño, the Atlantic Niño, tropical cyclones, and regional rainfall.


![[Source: Climate Reanalyzer (Climate Change Institute, University of Maine).](https://climatereanalyzer.org/wx/todays-weather/?var_id=sstanom&ortho=1&wt=1)](images/downloaded_figures/gfs_world-wt_sstanom_d1.png){width=100%}
